changelog: Added Connect to PC: use the agents running in AntiGem for VS Code on your PC from your phone, with the same chats live on both. Pair once in Settings → Connect to PC (pick the PC from Nearby PCs and type the 6-digit code VS Code shows), then switch between your PCs and this phone from the new PC button in the side bar
Added folder tabs in Files: open several folders side by side and copy between them (always on with a PC or server, turn them on with the new tabs button otherwise)

Claude Code subagents are listed under their chat in the side bar and open read-only; the agents chip in the Claude strip shows how many run and lists them as a tree, nested ones under the agent that started them. OpenCode child sessions and Codex spawned agents nest under their chat too
Fixed answered question cards: Claude Code no longer repeats every question in each answer, and OpenCode now shows each question with its own answer

Fixed OpenCode questions (single-choice options were missing, question and header were swapped, the card repeated in every reply). Custom providers now select all fetched models by default, with Select all / Select none

File links written relative to the project (like src/Main.kt) are now clickable; [text](photo.png) stays a link and only ![...](...) shows an image or video player. Open with: images open in the built-in viewer, and Share is last for every file

Fixed: images and subagents of chats on a PC or server now load, the terminal uses the phone when the PC does not allow a shell, "Go there" after saving a shared file no longer loads forever, and the side bar no longer opens by itself after a full-screen video
Jarvis can now set the effort when it starts Claude Code or Codex tasks and new chats
